title: The explicit unit comparison factors through forgotten scalar Ext
statement: For a field k and a scheme X over k with structure morphism f [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations], let U be the functor forgetting the k-action on scalar sheaves. Define s as the degree-zero integer class of the section 1 of the scalar tensor unit, using the constant-sheaf sections adjunction. For a scalar Ext class z from the tensor unit to a scalar sheaf F, define C(z)=s composed with U(z). Then scalarUnitAbelianComparison X(x) [new-sc-scalar-unit-comparison-family] equals C(scalarCohomologyExtEquiv f unit 1 x) for every degree-one unit-module cohomology class x. This is an identity on a single scheme; it involves no scheme morphism or inverse image.

proof.text: Evaluate the forgotten scalar-unit degree-zero class using Sheaf.H.equiv₀_naturality. Cancel constantScalarUnitIso.hom followed by its inverse, and apply the constant-sheaf adjunction homEquiv apply_symm_apply identity. The result is scalarUnitLinear f 1 = scalarMap f top 1 = 1, the integer-unit section defining scalarUnitAbelianComparison.

Apply mapExactFunctor_square to scalarFunctor f, the module-to-abelian functor, scalarAbelianForget, and the identity functor, with the definitionally reflexive functor isomorphism. Apply exactFunctorIdentityComparison to remove the identity Ext map. This identifies forgetting after restriction of scalars with directly forgetting the module action, despite their different Ext universes.

Unfold scalarCohomologyExtEquiv, scalarCohomologyExtMap, and scalarExtMap. Use Mathlib Ext.mapExactFunctor_comp and Ext.mapExactFunctor_mk₀, then the preceding functor-map equality. Apply Ext.comp_assoc and the degree-zero unit equality to obtain the factorization.

lean.statement:
theorem scalar_unit_abelian_ext_factorization (k : Type u) [Field k]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (x : scalarCohomology f (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) 1) :
    scalarUnitAbelianComparison X x =
      scalarAbelianExtComparison k X (scalarSheaf f (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)) 1
        (scalarCohomologyExtEquiv f (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) 1 x)
